description: Combine the current cooperative n=256 plus L1-preferred MathDx n=2048 global-best stack with the separated-scheduler, cached-stage-view tight-prefix CuTe n=1024 winner. Import only the batch-60 n=1024 scheduler, compact staging, pointers, and fixed view cache; preserve isolated MathDx operators and all n=512/n=4096/small/large paths, then validate cache resets, caller-stream state, cleanup, and the full grid.

Imported the separated batch60 n1024 CuTe scheduler, compact staging, cached pointers, and four fixed stage-view tuples onto the cooperative n256 plus L1-preferred grouped n2048 parent while preserving its isolated MathDx launches and all other dispatches. Build, caller-stream/kernelguard policy, 17 official tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 benchmark shapes passed. Aggregate measured 946.833 us; n256 measured 148.110 us, batch60 n1024 2150.382 us, and batch8 n2048 2496.241 us.

Cached the batch60 n1024 CuTe queue wrapper behind its caller-current queue handle, reusing the wrapper across all three rank-k stages while rebuilding it whenever the caller queue changes. Build, policy gates, 17 official tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 benchmark shapes passed. Aggregate measured 944.719 us versus 946.833 us before queue caching; target n1024 measured 2148.512 us versus 2150.382 us, with n256/n2048 at 147.320/2491.212 us.

Folded each batch60 n1024 trailing CuTe pointer and six immutable Int32 launch arguments into its cached stage tuple, removing per-stage shape/stride reads, scalar wrapping, and output-pointer indexing while retaining the caller-queue cache. Build, policy gates, official tests, fresh-input guard, and full benchmark grid passed. Target n1024 measured 2161.774 us versus 2148.512 us before stage-argument caching; aggregate measured 951.467 us versus 944.719 us amid n256/n512/n2048 variance.

Restored the best queue-cached stage path, fused upper-zero writes into its initial batch1024 lower-copy kernel, and removed the final upper-clear launch. Build, policy gates, 17 official tests, and fresh-input guard passed, but the active batch60 n1024 benchmark rejected the output with lower-triangular relative residual 0.207 because diagonal CuTe macrotiles rewrote upper elements after the initial clear; no aggregate metric was produced.

Restored required post-RankK upper cleanup and narrowed its exact batch60 n1024 persistent float4 kernel from 256 to 128 threads per block, leaving the queue-cached CuTe stage path unchanged. Build, policy gates, official tests, fresh-input guard, and all benchmark cells passed. Target measured 2149.544 us versus 2148.512 us at 256 threads; aggregate measured 946.199 us versus 944.719 us, with unchanged-shape variance.

Completed the post-RankK cleanup geometry sweep by narrowing the exact batch60 n1024 persistent float4 upper-clear kernel from 128 to 64 threads. Build, all policy and correctness gates, fresh-input guard, and every benchmark cell passed. Target measured 2147.078 us versus 2149.544 us at 128 threads and 2148.512 us at 256 threads; aggregate measured 946.567 us amid unrelated n256/n512/n2048 variance.

Replaced the final empty-panel preparation plus separate batch1024 upper clear with one 64-thread caller-queue kernel that writes the last 256x256 column-major factor into the output diagonal while zeroing every upper row segment. Build, policy gates, official tests, fresh-input guard, and full benchmark grid passed. Target measured 2185.380 us versus 2147.078 us for separate final factor preparation and cleanup; aggregate measured 950.168 us versus 946.567 us.

Combined the cooperative n256 plus L1-preferred grouped n2048 parent with the separated-scheduler, tight-prefix, cached-view batch60 n1024 CuTe path across seven measured trials. Exact integration reached 946.833 us; caller-queue-handle caching reached the best aggregate 944.719 us at ae1249a with target 2148.512 us; cached scalar stage tables measured 951.467 us; moving cleanup before RankK failed active-grid triangularity because diagonal CuTe macrotiles rewrote upper elements; 128- and 64-thread post-cleanup measured 946.199/946.567 us, with 64 threads giving the lowest target sample 2147.078 us at d721ff0; fused final-factor writeback plus cleanup measured 950.168 us and target 2185.380 us. All succeeded trials passed build, caller-stream/kernelguard gates, 17 official tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 benchmark cells. Local profiling was waived and hosted Brev was unavailable. Keep this line moving with stage-specialized compile-time RankK entry points, a diagonal-macrotile masked epilogue that removes upper cleanup safely, or FP32-to-FP16 conversion folded into the CuTe mainloop.
